title: Specify match rules and verify default parameters
lead: Write `docs/spec/match.md`: config fields, the in-repo seeded PRNG and placement, turn order, cycle limit, tie rule and result. Verify the default parameters accepted in C30 against a cited source.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** tournament scoring, replay format, implementation.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Goals 3 and 4 need a deterministic match with a defined tie rule. C30 accepts the Redcode '94 hill norms (core 8000, cycles 80000, max processes 8000) as a starting point but they are still unverified. C36 requires an in-repo seeded PRNG with a fixed algorithm so replays survive Go upgrades; this spec fixes that algorithm.

sections.heading: Failing tests
Implement
sections.body:
- Config fields from the data model: core size, cycle limit, max processes, min separation, seed. Give each a default and its valid range.
- PRNG (C36): one fully specified algorithm with integer-only steps (for example SplitMix64 or a PCG variant), the seed type, and how a value in [0, n) is drawn without modulo bias or with documented bias. Not math/rand. The implementer picks the algorithm and records it per C35 with a one-line reason.
- Placement: random non-overlapping start positions from the seed, honoring min separation, in a stated order; the error when placement is impossible.
- Turn: each live bot executes one instruction from the front of its queue, then requeues it; a bot with no processes is dead. Define bot order within a cycle and what one cycle counts.
- Result: winner, survivors at the cycle limit, cycles run.
- Tie rule and default min separation: PROJECT.md requires "a defined tie rule" and names no min separation. The implementer decides both and records each as a catalog decision with a one-line reason (C35); the reviewer checks them.
- Verify the three C30 defaults against a public source (ICWS'94 text or hill documentation; read-only). Cite it in the spec and record the confirmed defaults as a catalog decision. If no source can be found, keep the C30 values, mark them UNVERIFIED in the spec and the decision, and note it on this item.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- Every config field has a default and range; the three C30 defaults cite a source or are marked UNVERIFIED with a note on this item.
- The PRNG section has the algorithm, constants and test vectors; nothing refers to math/rand.
- `grep -nE 'TODO|TBD' docs/spec/match.md` prints nothing.
- `slicer catalog list --kind decision --json --lean` includes the defaults, PRNG, tie rule and min separation decisions; the reviewer checks each.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `slice/<id>-match-spec` in `.worktrees/<id>`. Document only. One commit when the owner asks.
